newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offer in Vietnam fuel oil at $8.20/T premium.
newsitem.headline: Low offer in Vietnam fuel oil at $8.20/T premium.

text.p: The lowest offer into state-owned Vietnam National Petroleum Import Corp's (Petrolimex) tender to buy 170-centistoke fuel oil was at $8.20 per tonne above Singapore spot quotes, industry sources said on Thursday.
Petrolimex might award six 27,000-tonne cargoes with a three percent sulphur content in this tender for July-September delivery, on a cost-and-freght (c-and-f) basis to Ho Chi Minh City.
The highest offer of fuel oil was made around $9.50 per tonne above Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f basis.

In its last tender for second quarter delivery, Petrolimex bought five 26,000-tonne cargoes of 170-centistoke fuel oil at premiums of between $8.00 and $9.00 per tonne to Singapore spot quotes, on a c-and-f basis.

The best offer of 83-octane leaded gasoline in the third quarter tender was of Russian origin at a premium of around $1.20 per barrel to Singapore spot naphtha quotes, c-and-f Ho Chi Minh City, Hongai or Danang.
Sources said Petrolimex might take eight cargoes of 18,000 tonnes each in this tender.

In its last tender for the second quarter, Vietnam bought six 18,000-tonne cargoes of 83-octane gasoline, all of which originated from Russia, at a premium of 80 cents per barrel to Singapore spot naphtha quotes, c-and-f basis.
The third quarter tender closed on June 27 and offers will be valid until July 4.
